notes: Deepening pass for the in-Drop pools (BAR HUD barks and the pre-seeded debrief candidates). Between-Drop voice (hub briefing, debrief, camp, roll) now comes from data/story/voices/ + tools/occasions_v1.py and is keyed by occasion, not mission number. These additions are merged into ketha_voice.json by tools/merge_ketha_additions.py; existing lines are kept.

debrief.victory: Held. Say it once, write it once, don't frame it.
A win. The ground agreed with us for ten minutes. Make it eleven next time.
We left on our feet and they didn't follow. I'll take that spelling of victory.
Done. The map changes tonight. So does the bill. Read both.
debrief.victory_clean: Everyone who went came back. I counted twice. I'm allowed one luxury.
Clean. That word is doing more work than it used to.
No one carried. No one was carried. Put that above the objective in the report.
In, out, intact. The roll didn't get longer. That's the whole debrief.
debrief.partial: Half kept, half owed. The owed half has interest.
We brought back a company and left an order. I know which one I'd rather have.
Unfinished. Not failed. I'm particular about the difference; the client won't be.
A hinge. Which way it swings is the next Drop's business.
debrief.defeat: Lost. Short word. It never gets smaller.
We lost the ground. Read the roster before anyone says the word ground again.
They held, we didn't. Write it exactly like that. The next sortie needs the truth more than we need comfort.
That's a defeat. Mark it. Then mark who's still standing, because that's the part we keep.
debrief.hero_lost: A name went down and the frame stayed. I'll write where. We decide what that means at the table.
They fell. The wreck's still on the field. Nothing's final until someone reclaims it or we do.
Down, not gone. Not yet. That 'yet' is the only thing I care about tonight.
I don't write the roll from the field. I write it from the camp, after everyone's had the chance to argue.
debrief.territory_lost: {zone} went while we were elsewhere. Ground doesn't wait and neither do the people on it.
Mark {zone} theirs. Then mark who was supposed to be watching it. Nobody. That's the problem.
{zone}, lost offscreen. Nobody of ours was there. That's a different kind of losing. It's cheaper and it's worse.
bark.hero_down: Name down! Hold that ground until it's carried. Nobody reclaims one of ours.
Frame's on the field. Rez on it now. I am not writing this one tonight.
They're down. Cover the wreck. The roll waits for nobody's permission but mine, and I'm not giving it.
Down! Rusk, door. Everyone else, shoulders.
bark.hero_recovered: Carried. On the bench, not the roll. Keep moving.
Back up. Someone had shoulders. I'll find out whose later.
Recovered. That's a door held. Now go through it.
Good. One less line to write tonight.
bark.extract_order: That's the order kept. Now keep the people. Extraction, go.
Done. Walk, don't loot. Wrecks wait; people don't.
Finished. The field will reconsider in about a minute. Be gone before it does.
Mark's down. Everyone who came, comes back. That's the second half of every order.
bark.midfight: Half done. This is where the bill gets written. Keep it short.
They've noticed us. Spend the surprise before it's spent for you.
Middle of it. Count your people, not your kills.
Keep the line. The field answers late and it answers loud.
bark.wave_warning: Column inbound. The clock has teeth. Decide now.
Here's their answer. Meet it where you chose, not where they did.
Reserve's committed. They want this ground back. Make them pay for every step of it.
Inbound. If you're going to leave, leave now. If you're going to stay, mean it.
bark.opening.economy: Mex first, then guns. The field pays the patient.
Build the budget before the argument. Then argue.
Economy map. Whoever feeds the line longest keeps it.
bark.opening.tempo: First to the mark owns it. Move.
Speed is the plan. Everything else is detail.
bark.opening.siege: Walls today. One bone at a time. Don't rush the chewing.
Bastion ahead. Respect the guns, then unmake them in order.
bark.opening.wild: The wilds are awake. Be brief, be loud, be gone.
Hives don't sleep. Neither should your perimeter.
bark.contact.economy: Contact on the works. Hit the extractors, leave the walls.
Their economy's in reach. Take it apart in the right order: power, then metal.
bark.contact.tempo: Contact. Don't stop to admire it. Through.
Here they are. Faster than them is the only armor you brought.
bark.contact.siege: Wall in range. One bone. Then step back and let it fall.
Guns on the bastion. Count them, then subtract.
bark.contact.wild: Hive contact. It doesn't negotiate. Neither do you, today.
Raptors on the line. They don't retreat. Make sure you can.
